issue.detail: Spec says synchronous reset but does not state whether reset has priority over data capture when both are asserted at a clock edge; contract assigns priority 1 to reset, but an alternative equal-priority or data-priority interpretation is plausible.
issue.spec_evidence: active high synchronous reset (reset output to 0)
issue.alternative: Data capture takes priority over synchronous reset when r==1 and d is sampled at the same posedge, so q follows d instead of resetting to 0.

issue.detail: Spec does not define initial power-up value of q before any posedge clk; contract states Q is stored and reset updates during reset, but no initial value is specified.
issue.alternative: q has an unknown or implementation-defined initial value before the first posedge clk, rather than being defined by the first reset or capture edge.
